Body.Content:
Microsoft Edge adds an Unsubscribe button to eligible website push notifications, allowing users to stop receiving notifications from a website directly from the notification, without opening browser settings. Administrators can continue to manage website notification permissions through existing enterprise policies.

GA date: January CY2027
